There will only ever be 21 million BTC.

Let's say Bitcoin has a total market value of $2.1 trillion.

$2.1 trillion ÷ 21 million BTC = $100,000 per Bitcoin.

Now imagine demand increases and the market values Bitcoin at $4.2 trillion.

$4.2 trillion ÷ 21 million BTC = $200,000
